Sandbox_CPI_EnginePowerPercent_tooltip: Scales engine drive torque before tire grip is applied. It affects acceleration and the ability to break traction, but does not change vehicle mass.
Sandbox_CPI_RoadResistancePercent_toolti: Scales rolling resistance, aerodynamic drag, and engine braking. Lower values give longer coasting; higher values slow vehicles sooner.
Sandbox_CPI_TireGripPercent_tooltip: Scales the final surface grip available to every tire. Tire condition, road surface, weather, and suspension condition are still applied.
Sandbox_CPI_RecoveryStrengthPercent_tool: Scales only the last-resort correction for an unintended spin. It does not change normal steering or an intentional handbrake/power drift. Set to 0 to disable recovery.
Sandbox_CPI_SteeringSensitivityPercent_t: Scales the requested wheel angle while preserving the current progressive steering and return rates. 100%% is the tested default.
Sandbox_CPI_DriftEntryDelay_tooltip: Continuous time at near-full throttle and meaningful steering input before power-oversteer assistance may activate. A real rear-axle traction loss is still required. The handbrake path is immediate.
Sandbox_CPI_VanillaCollisionResponse_too: Lets the native CarController and Bullet simulation own the short period after BaseVehicle reports a crash. Damage, crash sounds, and collision impulses remain vanilla. Disable to keep V2 forces active continuously.
